 Holiday shoppers can find seven discounted gift options through Good Morning America's Deals and Steals, presented by Tory Johnson on November 19, 2026. The selection includes kitchen accessories, reading lights, skincare, photo storage and household products, with prices starting at $4.50 and advertised discounts reaching 85 percent.
 The featured products cost no more than $20 before shipping. Individual offers include different delivery charges, purchase limits and product variations, making the final cost dependent on the selected item and order size.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 DEMDACO Kitchen Boas are available for $12, reduced from $24. The accessory keeps a kitchen towel around the user's neck for convenient access while cooking. Shipping costs $4.99 for individual purchases but becomes free when five items are ordered.
 Also Read 
 Retailers Cut Big-Ticket Holiday Inventory as Shipping Costs Rise 
 Glocusent Neck Reading Light costs $15, compared with its regular price of $39. The flexible, hands-free light features two adjustable beams, three lighting colors and adjustable brightness. Shipping costs $1.99, and purchases are limited to three per order.
 Glocusent's Original LED Neck Reading Light has a 4.8-out-of-5 customer rating from more than 860 reviews. Customer feedback highlights its usefulness for reading and small projects, although one reviewer found the neck fit larger than expected. The rating applies to the original listing and should not automatically be attributed to every model in the promotion.
 A Brighter Year offers mini coloring activities priced between $5 and $18, representing 50 percent off the listed regular prices. Available themes include holiday designs, flowers, food and animals. Some options include bundles and kits containing pencils and a travel pouch.
 Also Read 
 Amazon Sets Black Friday Sale for November 19 to 30 
 Shipping costs $4.99 or becomes free on orders exceeding $50. Reviews of the brand's mini book variety pack praise its portability and selection of themes, although one customer considered the regular-store price too high for a donation project.
 Picture Keeper's 32GB Photo Storage Device is priced at $20, down from $140, with free shipping. The device stores photos and other files without requiring a cloud subscription. According to the brand, its Picture Keeper MAX 32GB supports phones, tablets and computers and can resume interrupted backups.
 The Picture Keeper MAX 32GB product listing displays a 4.6-out-of-5 rating from 1,033 reviews. The promotion limits purchases to four devices per order. Buyers should distinguish the MAX 32GB model from other versions when comparing specifications and customer ratings.
 Also Read 
 Rising Shipping Costs Squeeze Small Retailers Ahead of Holidays 
 TruSkin skincare products range from $4.50 to $19, with advertised prices reflecting 50 percent discounts. The selection includes Vitamin C Serum, Vitamin C Super Serum+, hyaluronic acid products and smaller skincare gifts. Shipping is free, with a maximum of five items per order.
 TruSkin's Vitamin C Serum carries a 4.4-out-of-5 rating from 4,872 reviews on the brand's website. Its separate Vitamin C Super Serum has a 4.6 rating from 2,259 reviews. Customer experiences vary, with some praising the products and others reporting that the original serum did not suit their skin.
 CLEAN PEOPLE Laundry Care products cost between $6.50 and $16.50, representing half the listed regular prices. The promotion includes pre-measured detergent sheets in 32-load and 96-load packages, with scented and fragrance-free options. Shipping costs $3.99 or becomes free on orders above $35, while purchases are limited to six units per product.
 Also Read 
 US Shoppers Favor Gifts as Holiday Budgets Tighten 
 The brand's laundry sheets listing displays a 4.73-out-of-5 rating from more than 2,200 customer reviews. Customers frequently highlight the convenience of using pre-measured sheets instead of measuring liquid detergent.
 Baby Foot foot-care products complete the selection, with prices ranging from $7.50 to $12.50. The Original Exfoliation Foot Peel removes dead skin over time, while the Moisturizing Foot Mask provides hydration without an exfoliation process. A men's version also features larger booties.
 Shipping costs $4.29, but becomes free when customers purchase at least two items. The order limit is three products. The lavender-scented Original Exfoliation Foot Peel has a 4.0-out-of-5 rating from 895 reviews on Ulta, with customer feedback including positive experiences and reports of limited results.
